summary.en-US: Refine and declutter the X/Twitter web experience with local-only customization controls.

description.en-US:
Minimal X removes common distractions from the X/Twitter web interface and gives you controls for a cleaner timeline.

Features include:

* Hide promoted posts, trends, suggestions, view counts, and vanity metrics
* Customize timeline width and remove visual clutter around the timeline
* Simplify the left navigation and hide unused X/Twitter surfaces
* Hide Grok-related UI elements
* Keep preferences stored locally on your device

This extension does not collect analytics, does not transmit personal data, and does not require an external account.

developer_comments.en-US: This is a fork of the open-source Minimal Twitter extension, updated as Minimal X. It stores user preferences locally through browser storage and does not collect or transmit user data.

release_notes.en-US: Removed the automatic browser tab that opened after installing the extension.

version.approval_notes: The remaining validator warnings are from generated Next.js static-export runtime chunks in the extension settings UI. The source package includes the full popup and content-script source, lockfiles, and build instructions. Content-script innerHTML usage flagged in the first local pass was removed before submission. The extension stores preferences locally and does not collect or transmit user data.
